data.summary: Reviews show strong signs of manipulation. A perfect 5.0 rating with 40 reviews across two Google listings, combined with zero reviews on all other platforms (despite having a Yelp page), suggests artificial review inflation. The reviews themselves are generic and lack the specific details, varied perspectives, and occasional criticism typical of authentic customer experiences.
fake_signals: No reviews on any other platform despite Yelp page existing
All Google reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
Reviews lack specific project details, timelines, or crew names
No mention of pricing, estimates, or common contractor concerns
authentic_signals: Some reviews mention specific events like tree damage
data.discrepancy_explanation: Perfect 5.0 rating on Google with 40 reviews is highly unusual for any contractor, especially with no reviews on other major platforms (Yelp, Angi, Houzz, Trustpilot). The Yelp page exists but has no rating or reviews, which is a red flag for selective review management.
